en.quote: In that day shall thy mouth be opened to him which is escaped, and thou shalt speak, and be no more dumb: and thou shalt be a sign unto them; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
en.riddle: and thou shalt speak, and be no more dumb
en.speaker: thy mouth

he.quote: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִפָּתַח פִּיךָ אֶת-הַפָּלִיט וּתְדַבֵּר, וְלֹא תֵאָלֵם עוֹד וְהָיִיתָ לָהֶם לְמוֹפֵת וְיָדְעוּ כִּֽי-אֲנִי יְהוָֽה
he.speaker: פִּיךָ
